title: With a relay I don't know what has changed or whether I have to save (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
When I set up a relay for an srs repo I have a rather large problem. 

I dont know what has changed, and I don't know how if I have to save? 

I also probably need to allow a remote agent to see if anything needs to be saved
